title: LOFT LULA 'EAST' in East Nashville, TN
description:
Local musician + photographer sharing their three story townhome located in  East Nashville, TN.

The space
Enjoy our three story townhome in East Nashville,  just minutes from Downtown Nashville.

This brand new minimalistic townhome features a roof top patio off of the bedroom where you can enjoy your morning cup of coffee. 

OR, take a walk to the locals favourite coffee shop  ★CREMA★ just one block away.

★Note: Bedroom on the second floor does not have a door and is an open layout.★

★ ★ Patio furniture is put away for the remainder of the season! ★ ★

Guest access
•Guests will have exclusive access to the entire townhome. 
•Self check-in at 4:00pm with keyless entry.
•Unit #9.

REMINDER:

•ONLY 4 guests allowed, unless otherwise approved by Loft Lula.
•PARTIES will NOT be tolerated. Immediate removal from the property will take place.

Other things to note
FREE PARKING:

•Parking is located throughout the gated community. 
•Any open spot is free to take.
